reviews.author: Tiana Chan
reviews.text: My husband met Jeff & his team while they were cutting down trees in the neighborhood today, they were really friendly & were happy to help! Jeff made sure it was done perfect even if it takes them just a little longer, they clearly want to see their customers happy & wanna do everything the right way! Our kids were so excited, we've had the tree swing for months & if it wasn't for them it would have never gone up. I feel like most people wouldn't have cared to take time out for a "small" job like that, but they did & it just shows their good character & how they treat everyone with kindness, definitely recommend calling them for all your tree needs!

reviews.author: Crystal Stone
reviews.text: Jeff and his crew are amazing! Excellent communication and went above and beyond what we asked for. We had a very tall dead pine tree that was surrounded by a fence and a pool in the vicinity. He was able to come in and drop it with ease into our back field. No harm to the fence or any property. While he was here we saw a second tree not looking good. This one was much larger. He was unable to get his equipment in the fence but came up with a plan and dropped that tree, between two fences, with ease and again no damage to anything. We didn’t require any clean up as we were just going to leave it for our goats but Jeff and his crew cut up the giant trunk and stacked them to make a playground for the goats to climb on. They picked up all the debris that scattered when the tree hit the ground. We can’t say enough good things about these guys and we will definitely be calling Jeff again for more work in the future!

reviews.author: Nate's Lock & Key
reviews.text: I was outside and seen Jeff and his crew at a neighbors house and walked over and asked for a price to hang my kids swing on a high branch and his price was perfect and he was happy to help. Jeff is very professional and friendly, he got the job done right. Very pleased with Jeff and his crew, if I ever need any tree work, Gaston Tree will be my go to!

reviews.author: Lori Taylor
reviews.text: Jeff, the owner of Gaston Tree, and his crew were outstanding from start to finish. They were professional, hardworking, and very down-to-earth, which made the whole experience easy and stress-free. They took care of a fallen tree from the recent storm along with several others we had been putting off, and handled everything efficiently. What really stood out was the cleanup, once they were done, our yard looked even better than it did before they arrived. You would have never known they were here (in the best way possible). I highly recommend Jeff and his team for anyone needing tree work done right.

reviews.author: David B
reviews.text: Jeff and his team recently took care of some tree trimming, stump grinding and brush removal on my property. Jeff was the quickest to respond to my RFQ via the BBB website and worked with me on a very fair price and timing. The work was completed quickly, safely and more thoroughly than I expected. Jeff’s communication throughout the project and his follow up afterwards demonstrate his concern for, and commitment to the customer. I would call Jeff and Gaston Tree LLC again.

reviews.author: Cody Carelock
reviews.text: I had a couple 80 plus ft trees that were to close to my house, always worried me during storms especially during wind. They were way too big for me to try and handle. I called Jeff with Gaston tree to get a quote to remove them. He immediately came within the next hour, gave me multiple options and we discussed a plan. He came and completed the job the same week all In one day. Did a very good job, did everything I asked and cleaned up when he was finished. I appreciate Jeff and his crew and if I need anymore tree work completed he will be the first I reach out to.

reviews.author: Corlis Teare
reviews.text: Gaston Trees are great people. Everyone is aware that cutting trees is expensive. They have the best prices and by far the best service. They cut 4 trees and ground the stumps. They spread out the grinding making it level. They also trimmed my neighbor’s limbs off my roof. When they were done they cleaned up everything including blowing off my roof, decking and street. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Mary & Roger S
reviews.text: I want to thank Jeff and his crew for the excellent job they did removing two very large trees. Everything went smooth, no problems at all. Jeff and his crew even helped me cut up some firewood. Stumps and roots were ground down below ground level with a stump grinder. He did all this for a very good price. Even helped level the ground back. If you need trees removed this is your Man.

reviews.author: Danny McKinney
reviews.text: Jeff, and his crew cut down an Ash Tree beside my house. He went beyond what my expectations were. Price was great and Jeff knew exactly what he was doing. His whole crew was great to work with. I'm going to get him back to cut down more trees in the future. I would highly recommend Gaston Tree to anyone!

reviews.author: Andy Shen
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with Gaston Tree, and I had a great experience. The owner, Jeff, is kind, professional, knowledgeable, and truly dedicated to providing top-notch service. He provided me with a free quote for the project and shared his advice, which gave me options and ultimately resulted in a reasonable quote compared to other companies. I hired them to remove several Leyland trees, grind the stumps, and handle all the debris removal, and they exceeded my expectations every step of the way. Jeff and his crew arrived on time, thoroughly assessed the project, and got straight to work. They handled the tree removal safely and efficiently, and the stump grinding was completed with precision. What impressed me most was how they left the property spotless, every bit of debris was cleared away, leaving my yard cleaner than before they arrived. They are very reliable and professional. Throughout the entire process, Jeff was easy to communicate with and made sure I was happy with the results. He does business the right way and I know that I can trust him. If you need tree removal, stump grinding, or debris cleanup done right, I highly recommend Gaston Tree. Thank you so much to Jeff and his team!

reviews.author: Kevin Kinker
reviews.text: Jeff and Felipe took down a massive pine tree. Jeff had a small margin of error to work with and I was darn near skeptical, but he nailed it. Laid that beast of tree down right where he wanted. It was quite a show. My kids enjoyed it. Now this next comment may be biased because he is my neighbor. But Jeff is a man with a strong moral compass that you can trust to do the right thing. Because, naturally, jobs won’t always go smoothly. But what you can count on is for Jeff to make it right. He’s not going to ever do ya wrong because that’s not the kind of man he is. Call him if you need a tree removed. You won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Joshua Meeks
reviews.text: Jeff and his crew did excellent work in my yard. He came out and spent time looking at other trees, and pointed out some concerns I had not noticed. Price was very fair.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: I was needing six very large trees removed that were too close to our house. After getting several estimates I chose Gaston Tree. The owner Jeff was very nice and seemed very knowledgeable of the work. He was also the least expensive of all my estimates. They arrived on time as promised, did all the work and cleaned up very promptly. I would not hesitate trusting Jeff and Gaston Tree for any tree service in the future. Very good company.

reviews.author: Mike Holt
reviews.text: Jeff and team did a great job. They showed up on time, made recommendations, had all the right equipment and cleaned the job site. I will using them again.

reviews.author: Kim Jones
reviews.text: I had the best experience ever. The owner-Jeff was awesome to work with. He was the cheapest of 3 estimates I had gotten and not only did he do the work he quoted me, he did extra. I am extremely pleased with the work and the service from Jeff and his staff. If you need a tree service that's professional and does what they say they are going to do at a very fair price, then Jeff is the person to call. I will be calling him for any further tree services that I need. Just terrific experience all around. I would give him more than 5 stars if I could. Thank you!!

reviews.author: David Pleasants
reviews.text: Jeff and his crew removed some trees, grinded some stumps, and bushhogged some kudzu for me. Great job at a reasonable price and easy to work with.

reviews.author: Lindsey Jumper
reviews.text: Tree fell last night and we called and he came TODAY and removed it off our carport!! Such a great guy with better service.

reviews.author: Donna Clemmer
reviews.text: Jeff and his crew did an amazing job! He cut down a tree for us. We are very pleased with his work. I would highly recommend him to anyone needing tree service.

reviews.author: John Webb
reviews.text: We had a very large tree on our property line which had recently died. Gaston Tree was in the neighborhood doing a neighbors trees and I walked over and talked with Jeff. I mentioned we were concerned for the kids next door with a dead tree that could fall in their direction at any time. He gave us a very reasonable quote and took care of it that day after an already long day for them. A very professional team! I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Jeff Cable
reviews.text: I had a tree fall from a neighbor’s property onto mine, and after calling around for quotes, I chose Gaston Tree. Their pricing was not only competitive but offered great value for the service provided. Even though they originally said they’d be by the following week, they ended up coming the very next day, a pleasant surprise! The crew was fast, efficient, and did a great job cleaning everything up. Really impressed with their service and would definitely recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Fayaz Lakhany
reviews.text: Jeff is the best in the business - honest, reliable, and true to his word. Highly recommend him for any tree work!

reviews.author: Chasidy C
reviews.text: I highly recommend this company if you need any tree work done. They were professional, punctual, and did a great job. The price he quoted was reasonable and did not change the day the work was completed. I will definitely go back to them if I need any more trees cut down.

reviews.author: Jayne Bates
reviews.text: Gaston Tree just cut down 4 trees for us. 2 in the woods close to our fence and 2 close to our home. Saying they are hardworking experts is an understatement! The precision was amazing! On top of being experts and really good clean up, the cost was lower than 3 other places we called. The owner is really great to work with and showed up when he said he would! We have nothing negative to say and really wish all businesses operated like this.

reviews.author: ashley blair
reviews.text: Such an awesome experience. Jeff was prompt and extremely knowledgeable! We would absolutely work with him again and recommend him to anyone we know!

reviews.author: Natasha Cordell
reviews.text: If you’re looking for someone who’s honest, hardworking, and truly knows what they’re doing, look no further! This tree service is reliable, professional, and treats every job like it’s their own backyard. The quality of the work is top-notch, and you can tell they genuinely care about doing things the right way. Highly recommend to anyone needing tree work done, you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Tyler Ghorley
reviews.text: Excellent customer service and reasonable pricing. Jeff is very professional and would highly recommend his company to anyone looking for tree work.

reviews.author: S Lazarus
reviews.text: Great customer service! The job was handled with good care and detail. Price was also competitive with all the others. Would recommend 10/10!

reviews.author: RAY LAROSA
reviews.text: Professional service and great customer service! Great price, I would recommend them to everyone that needs tree service.

reviews.author: Alec Justason
reviews.text: Did more than asked and was very respectful to the area. I’ll return if I ever need his business again.

reviews.author: Scott Haley
reviews.text: Jeff at Gaston Tree was extremely easy to work with. The work was performed quickly and was very reasonably priced. Would highly recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Morgan Jones
reviews.text: Needed 120+ year old Oak tree next to my house cut down. Honestly one of the biggest trees I’ve ever seen in my life! Jeff and his crew gave us the best quote and immediate service. Job took 1 day - team was quick, efficient, and left no mess! 10/10 and would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Gail White
reviews.text: I am pleased with the price, precise work, and quick clean up from them. I would use again and recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Charles Morgan
reviews.text: Needed some tree work done, Just by chance,I saw Gaston Tree doing a job.I stopped and talked to owner,(Jeff) He contacted me same day,Gave me a quote,4 days later ,showed up on time,Done a great job,More than I expected.Great Personality,I would definitely recommend this company to anyone.He got 2 more jobs up the street,And everyone was happy with his work also Thanks Again Jeff be safe

reviews.author: S Randall
reviews.text: Jeff and his crew were a pleasure to work with from start to finish. He provided the best quote in the area and completed the job in a timely manner. The project involved detailed work around a fence, but they handled it with great care just as promised. The quality and professionalism really stood out. Highly recommend! 10/10.
